title: banksia nervosa
intro: Banksia nervosa, commonly known as the island banksia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Proteaceae. It is native to the coastal areas of Western Australia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Banksia nervosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral effects.
